team.title: Team
team.subtitle: Give your team their own login. They can handle orders and see who needs a call and what is running low, nothing else.
team.emptyHint: Add someone and give them the email and password you choose.
team.access: Team members can work with orders (calls, status, edits, restocking returns) and see the "Needs a call" and "Running low" cards. They never see statistics, costs, profit, products or settings.
team.limit: You have reached the limit of {max} team members.
team.deleteText: This account will be signed out and removed. The orders they handled stay as they are.
team.name: Name
team.emailHint: They sign in at the same studio page with this email.
team.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Share it with them; they can't change it themselves.
team.newPasswordHint: Leave empty to keep the current one. A new password signs them out everywhere.
team.activeHint: Turn off to block their access without deleting the account.
team.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
